Only 22% of remote listings show a pay figure. The other 78% just say “DOE.”

DOE means “determined on experience.” Of 4,280 active remote listings on Loker Dollar, 3,340 leave the salary blank. That leaves you guessing the USD rate your skills deserve.

But a hidden number is not always a red flag. Companies use DOE to stay flexible on budget and tailor pay to seniority—which can push top candidates above market average, especially in fields like AI, senior leadership, and specialized healthcare.

How to handle a DOE role:
• Research global benchmarks for your role first.
• Quantify your impact with concrete metrics.
• Anchor with the high end of the range you found.
• Ask about benefits, equity, and bonuses too.

One real example: Online Consumer Panels America pays $25–$45/hour for product assessments with no experience required. Among 4,280 listings, 2,735 accept applicants from any country, and 1,213 were posted in the last 7 days.
